notes.title: Closed Beta is approaching!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,
We've been working hard on developing the game for the last few weeks and now we're happy to say that the new Steam Next Fest June demo is ready!

[h1][b]Now we need you![/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43725476/4fdfac47ef143a9522bf629fb86ce999b06d8e64.png[/img]

We're running a closed beta to collect player feedback before the Steam Next Fest starts to improve our demo.

The closed beta will have much more content than the old public demo, allowing you to see the variety and complexity of the other levels of the game. 

You will be able to play 6 levels and try some of the main Siheyuan game mechanics, the modifiers!

[list]
[*] [b]Mirrored pass:[/b] Once passed, tiles end up in the opposite area
[*] [b]Delayed pass:[/b] Once passed, tiles disappear before entering the other player’s area with a short delay.
[*] [b]Purple:[/b] Tiles are spawned mostly in purple (totally useless), possibly causing players to look for yellow tiles to erase them.
[*] [b]Yellow:[/b] Tiles are spawned mostly in yellow, possibly causing a lot of previously placed tiles to be erased.
[*] [b]Clock:[/b] Tiles can only be passed in one direction (clockwise).
[*] [b]Counter clock:[/b] Tiles can only be passed in one direction (counterclockwise).
[/list]

[h3][url=https://youtu.be/NBcFGHm7U78]Here's a new little video that teases lots of the new stuff in the game.[/url][/h3]

[h3][url=https://forms.gle/zMUDenQkRz9GQVmc6]Sign up now using this form.[/url][/h3]

And that's all for now.

See you soon!
:)

notes.title: Hello tile lovers!
notes.content:
Hello tile lovers from all over the world!
I just wanted to say hi to all the people who started following this minimalistic test of coordination called [b]Siheyuan[/b].

After years of globetrotting as a playful multiplayer installation, the game is finally coming to Steam in July 2023.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43725476/6629863fe231d0854b0d87e0dd362bd4d7b5afaf.jpg[/img]

Siheyuan was originally conceived as a site-specific installation at Beijing Design Week 2015, in collaboration with game maker [b]Aran Koning[/b] (part of [b]Sokpop collective[/b]) and [b]Francesco Fontana[/b] (music and sound effects). Since then, it has been selected for several international awards and showcased at festivals like [b]IndieCade[/b], [b]A MAZE[/b], [b]Berlin, and Milan Games Week[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43725476/24f3460d25a82ec727ebfb1275875c1a902811d1.jpg[/img]

The goal of Siheyuan is simple, but far from easy: to place the falling tiles in the matching color slots of the central grid(s).
Juggle tiles between the 4 game areas in single-player mode, or pass them to your friends in multiplayer mode (up to 4P), talking, collaborating, and sharing (or shouting) your strategy.
The game is inspired in its layout and dynamics by the tradition of "siheyuan", historical courtyards of Beijing, China.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43725476/4784bba60261eba3201166eacb270ed02f91bb16.png[/img]

We also want to thank our players for [b]downloading the demo 4,000 times[/b]!
All feedback is welcome, please don't be shy and let us know what you think of the game.

If you want to be an active part of the project, [url=https://discord.gg/x7uv2cBr]join us on Discord[/url], give us your feedback, and reserve yourself a place during the beta testing.

And that's all for this first post.

See you soon!
:)
